name: Oregon Coast & Crater Lake
positioning: Discover the Pacific Northwest on our guided Oregon Coast & Crater Lake Tour. Includes the Columbia Gorge and starts/ends in Portland. Book today!
overview: Envision the ultimate Pacific Northwest road trip: a seamless, 7-day guided loop from Portland that brings you face-to-face with Oregon’s most legendary landscapes without any of the planning stress. Your adventure begins along the rugged Oregon Coast, where you will watch the sun set over crashing waves from your oceanfront hotels in Newport and Gold Beach, marvel at dramatic wonders like Thor’s Well and the Heceta Head Lighthouse, and cruise the waves of Depoe Bay to spot magnificent wild whales. You won’t just see the scenery—you’ll be right in the heart of it as you blast down the wild Rogue River on a thrilling hydro-jet boat tour, stand beneath the world’s tallest living trees in the ancient Redwood State and National Parks, and watch wild sea lions play at the mouth of the Klamath River. Heading inland, you will stand in awe on the rim of Crater Lake National Park, gazing out at the impossibly deep blue volcanic waters and Wizard Island before heading through the high-desert energy of Bend and the fascinating lava fields of Newberry Volcano. Your journey reaches a breathtaking finale beneath the glacier-carved peak of Mount Hood as you enter the magnificent Columbia River Gorge, where you will feel the mist of the iconic, 620-foot Multnomah Falls and share a farewell lunch at the historic lodge. Traveling in the casual comfort of a premium, small-group Sprinter van with an expert local guide, this tour perfectly balances fresh farm-to-table dining and spectacular daily walks with the absolute best bucket-list landmarks the region has to offer.
itinerary_raw: Day 1: Arrival in Portland, Willamette Valley Wine Country & The Dramatic Oregon Coast Your Pacific Northwest adventure begins the moment you touch down in the vibrant city of Portland, Oregon. Your professional tour guide will greet you at the Portland International Airport (PDX) arrivals area, where you will join a select group of fellow adventurers in our premium, comfortable Mercedes-Benz Sprinter van. Leaving the city behind, we journey west through the lush, vineyard-draped hills of the famed Willamette Valley as the landscape shifts toward the raw beauty of the Pacific Ocean. As we hit the iconic Pacific Coast Highway, we will wind through charming seaside towns like Lincoln City and Depoe Bay, stopping to explore the rugged cliffs of the Boiler Bay Overlook. This unique marine ecological area is a hotspot for coastal wildlife; stand on the windswept headlands to watch for wild gray whales breaching in the surf and seabirds soaring over the crashing waves. By late afternoon, we arrive in the historic coastal hub of Newport, Oregon, checking into the oceanfront Hallmark Resort where every room offers stunning beach views. To celebrate the start of our journey, we gather for a fantastic, curated farm-to-table welcome dinner at a premier local restaurant. You will indulge in an authentic Pacific Northwest culinary experience, featuring fresh fish caught right off the local boats that morning. After dinner, the evening is yours to embrace the coastal elements—take an inspiring twilight walk along the sandy shoreline, breathe in the crisp salt air, and watch a spectacular Oregon sunset sink beneath the Pacific horizon as the tide rolls in. Meals Covered: Dinner Lodging: Hallmark Resort, Newport Oregon Day 2: Historic Lighthouses, Marine Gardens & Depoe Bay Whale Watching Cruise Wake up to the sound of crashing waves and prepare for an action-packed day dedicated to discovering the rugged beauty and rich marine life of the Central Oregon Coast. Our morning adventure kicks off just north of Newport at the spectacular Yaquina Head Outstanding Natural Area. Here, you will stand in awe beneath the historic Yaquina Head Lighthouse—Oregon’s tallest beacon—before hiking down to explore the vibrant Yaquina Head Marine Gardens. This protected intertidal zone offers an up-close look at a thriving coastal ecosystem, where you can explore volcanic tide pools teeming with colorful sea stars, anemones, and fascinating marine life. The thrill intensifies midday as we head to the "Whale Watching Capital of the Oregon Coast" for an unforgettable ocean excursion. You will board a specialized sea vessel for a premium, 2-hour Depoe Bay whale watching tour with the expert skippers at Dockside Depoe Bay. This stretch of the Pacific is a world-renowned sanctuary for majestic Gray Whales, many of whom are regular residents recognized by the crew by their distinct tail and body markings. Keep your camera ready as these gentle giants breach and blow spout water just feet from the boat, and keep an eye out for migrating Humpback and Blue whales that frequently pass through these nutrient-rich waters. Following this exhilarating wildlife encounter and a delicious lunch at a local coastal eatery, the afternoon is entirely yours to shape. Spend it wandering the historic bayfront of Newport, Oregon, exploring local artisan shops, or relaxing on the sandy beaches directly outside the Hallmark Resort to recharge for the epic miles ahead. Meals Covered: Breakfast & Lunch Lodging: Hallmark Resort, Newport Oregon Day 3: The Ultimate Pacific Coast Highway Road Trip—Newport to Gold Beach Prepare for one of the most visually spectacular driving days in North America as we journey south along the world-famous Pacific Coast Highway. This day is custom-built for photography enthusiasts and outdoor adventurers, showcasing the wild, untamed geology of the Southern Oregon Coast. Our guided tour features a series of active coastal stops where you will step out of our premium vehicle to witness the raw power of the ocean. We will marvel at the churning surf of Devil’s Churn, a deep chasm carved into volcanic rock, and stand beside Thor’s Well, the famous, seemingly bottomless sinkhole that swallows the ocean tide. We'll capture panoramic views from Captain Cook Point and look out over the dramatic sea stacks from the windswept bluffs of Cape Blanco—the westernmost point in Oregon. Along the way, we'll visit the stunning, cliff-perched Heceta Head Lighthouse, one of the most photographed and iconic working lighthouses in the United States. After a scenic midday lunch stop in the historic coastal town of Florence, our expedition continues south into the coastal adventure hub of Gold Beach, Oregon. We will check into our oceanfront rooms at the SureStay Plus Hotel by Best Western, where every single room features its own private balcony designed for soaking in the panoramic ocean views. In the evening, the group will gather for a hearty, authentic coastal dinner. Afterward, the sunset is yours to enjoy: embark on an invigorating beach walk right to the mouth of the legendary Rogue River or explore the scenic shoreline around Turtle Rock Creek, letting the soothing sounds of the crashing Pacific surf wrap up an unforgettable day of exploration. Meals Covered: Breakfast & Dinner Lodging: SureStay Plus Hotel by Best Western, Gold Beach Oregon Day 4: Wild & Scenic Rogue River Jet Boat Adventure & The Northern California Border Gear up for an adrenaline-pumping morning on the water as we shift our focus from the ocean to one of America’s most legendary waterways. Today, you will embark on a thrilling, 64-mile mail-run excursion aboard a high-speed Rogue River hydro-jet boat. This high-octane river adventure blasts through shallow riffles and navigates deep into the federally designated Wild & Scenic Rogue River canyon. You will zoom directly beneath the jaw-dropping, 400-foot sheer rock walls of Copper Canyon, surrounded by untouched wilderness. Keep your eyes peeled and your camera ready; this pristine corridor is teeming with Pacific Northwest wildlife, and it is common to spot osprey diving for fish, river otters playing in the eddies, black bears foraging on the shoreline, and black-tailed deer moving through the trees. Along the way, your expert river pilot shares the captivating local folklore, native history, and unique botany of the canyon. The excitement on the river is paired with a fantastic, wilderness lunch served on an open-air deck overlooking the rushing waters (or inside with panoramic glass views of the canyon). Back on land, our overland journey continues as our premium Sprinter van winds its way down the final, breathtaking stretch of the Southern Oregon shoreline. Crossing the state line into Northern California, we arrive in the historic coastal city of Crescent City, California, for the evening. After checking into the comfortable Best Western Plus Northwood Inn, you have a relaxing evening to yourself to explore the local harbor, sample California coastal cuisine, and rest up for tomorrow's journey into the land of the giants. Meals Covered: Breakfast & Lunch Lodging: Best Western Plus Northwood Inn, Crescent City CA Day 5: Ancient Redwood Rainforests, Klamath River Sea Lions & Journey Inland to Shady Cove Prepare to stand in the presence of living giants this morning as we plunge into the emerald canopies of the world’s tallest trees. Today’s eco-adventure takes us deep into the heart of the UNESCO World Heritage-listed Redwood National and State Parks. We will hike through the ancient, primordial groves of Jedediah Smith Redwoods State Park—home to some of the most massive, untouched old-growth redwoods on the planet—as well as the lush, fern-draped trails of Prairie Creek Redwoods and Del Norte Coast Redwoods State Park. Walking beneath these 300-foot-tall titans is a humbling, bucket-list experience that perfectly captures the untamed spirit of the Pacific Northwest. After leaving the deep forest, we head to the jaw-dropping dramatic coastline where the powerful Klamath River empties into the Pacific Ocean. We’ll explore the scenic river overlook for an incredible wildlife viewing opportunity, watching wild sea lions fish, bark, and play in the roaring ocean surf. Midday, we bid farewell to the coast and guide our premium vehicle inland, crossing back over the state line into Oregon. The maritime fog gives way to sun-drenched forests and river canyons as we wind our way toward the Cascade Mountains. We end our day of exploration in the quaint, welcoming riverfront town of Shady Cove, Oregon. After checking into our peaceful accommodations at the Edgewater Inn, nestled right along the banks of the rushing Rogue River, you have a relaxing evening to enjoy dinner in town, unwind by the water, and prepare for tomorrow’s ascent up the volcano. Meals Covered: Breakfast & Lunch Lodging: Edgewater Inn, Shady Cove Oregon Day 6: Crater Lake National Park & Mountain Culture in Bend Prepare for the undeniable crown jewel of your inland journey as we ascend into the Cascade Range to witness one of the world's most spectacular geological wonders. Today, we travel north to Crater Lake National Park, home to America’s deepest and most pristine body of water. Formed over 7,000 years ago by the cataclysmic collapse of Mount Mazama, Crater Lake is globally renowned for its immense depth, pure volcanic water, and an intensely brilliant blue color that defies description. We begin our alpine exploration with a stop at the park's Visitor Center to uncover the fascinating history and volcanic formation of the caldera, followed by a hearty breakfast at the historic Crater Lake Lodge. Next, we hit the trails for an exhilarating, high-altitude hike up to Garfield Peak, where you will be rewarded with panoramic, bird's-eye vistas of the entire lake and the sheer volcanic cliffs that frame it. Following a delicious lunch at the Crater Lake Dining Room, the adventure continues with a spectacular two-hour guided drive around the legendary Rim Drive. This scenic highway traces the caldera’s edge, offering countless postcard-perfect photo opportunities, sweeping vistas of Wizard Island, and a chance to take an optional, rewarding hike up to The Watchman Peak for even more jaw-dropping views of the surrounding wilderness. After bidding farewell to this natural wonder, we cruise north into Central Oregon, arriving in the high-desert mountain city of Bend, Oregon. You will have the evening to get acquainted with the vibrant energy of Bend—the region’s premier hub for craft breweries, artisan dining, and outdoor culture—before settling into your premium accommodations at The Newberry Hotel for a well-deserved night's rest. Meals Covered: Breakfast & Lunch Lodging: The Newberry Hotel, Bend Oregon Day 7: Newberry Volcanic Landscapes, Mount Hood Vistas & The Columbia River Gorge Grand Finale Your final day of exploration kicks off with an unforgettable volcanic adventure just south of Bend. We will head into the rugged, dramatic landscapes of the Newberry National Volcanic Monument, an active volcanic area where you can hike through ancient lava flows and explore unique geological features. After conquering the volcanic trails, our premium Sprinter van guides you north toward the final crown jewel of our Pacific Northwest loop. As we journey back toward the city, we will trace the majestic base of Mount Hood, offering spectacular, panoramic views of its glacier-carved peaks before descending directly into the world-renowned Columbia River Gorge National Scenic Area. Once inside this federally protected river canyon, the landscape transforms into a dramatic canvas of emerald moss and plunging waterfalls. Our signature stop brings you face-to-face with the legendary Multnomah Falls, the second-tallest year-round waterfall in the United States. You will stand in awe on the viewing platforms as you watch the roaring waters plunge a dramatic 620 feet from its origin on Larch Mountain. To celebrate the incredible miles and lifelong memories shared over the last week, we gather for a special group farewell lunch at the historic Multnomah Falls Lodge, enjoying a delicious meal with sweeping views overlooking the mighty Columbia River. Following lunch, we make the short, seamless drive back to the Portland International Airport (PDX) for a late afternoon drop-off, concluding the ultimate, bucket-list loop of Oregon’s natural wonders. Meals Covered: Breakfast & Lunch

overview: 4-Day Guided Thru-Hike Embark on the ultimate Yosemite adventure with this 4-day, 3-night out-and-back guided backpacking tour. Beginning at the famous Happy Isles Trailhead, this route takes you up the breathtaking Mist Trail, establishes basecamp in Little Yosemite Valley, and culminates in a thrilling ascent of the iconic Half Dome. With all permits and logistics handled by our expert guides, you can focus on the awe-inspiring waterfalls, granite domes, and the climb of a lifetime.

itinerary_raw: Overview Day 1: Welcome to Yosemite Valley Your journey begins in the heart of the park at the North Pines Backpacker’s Camp. Meet your guide and fellow trekkers for a thorough gear check, safety briefing, and the distribution of group equipment and trail meals. Spend your first evening relaxing and bonding with your group under the towering granite cliffs, getting plenty of rest for the climb ahead. Day 2: The Mist Trail to Basecamp After breaking camp in the Valley, we head to the Happy Isles Trailhead to begin our ascent. Today’s hike takes us up the steep and spectacular Mist Trail, where you will experience the sheer power of Vernal and Nevada Falls up close. We will climb from the valley floor into the backcountry, arriving at Little Yosemite Valley to establish our basecamp for the next two nights. Day 3: The Half Dome Summit Today is entirely dedicated to conquering the legendary Half Dome cables! Basing ourselves in Little Yosemite Valley gives us the flexibility to time our summit attempt for the best possible experience. An early morning start for a sunrise summit is ideal, providing stunning lighting and leaving time for a backup attempt if afternoon weather rolls in. Alternatively, an evening ascent for a sunset summit offers equally breathtaking views of the High Sierra and a quieter trail. Day 4: Sunrise Summits & The John Muir Trail If weather or trail conditions prevented our climb yesterday, we will make a final early-morning push for the Half Dome summit at sunrise. Afterward, we will pack up our basecamp and begin our scenic descent. We will hike back down to the valley floor via the iconic John Muir Trail (JMT), enjoying panoramic views of Liberty Cap and Nevada Fall before concluding our unforgettable trek back at Curry Village.
